title: Snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#7fd4f0'/>
  <!-- bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='20' fill='#eaf7ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#bfe8fb' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='15' fill='#f4fbff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#bfe8fb' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='11' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#bfe8fb' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='28' r='1.8' fill='#2b2f6b'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='28' r='1.8' fill='#2b2f6b'/>
  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <polygon points='50,31 50,34 62,32.5' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 34 Q50 37 55 34' fill='none' stroke='#2b2f6b' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#2b2f6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#2b2f6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#2b2f6b'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x='39' y='38' width='22' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#e63950'/>
  <rect x='55' y='40' width='6' height='13' rx='2.5' fill='#e63950'/>
  <rect x='55' y='48' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- hat -->
  <rect x='40' y='21' width='20' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2b2f6b'/>
  <rect x='43' y='8' width='14' height='13' rx='2' fill='#2b2f6b'/>
  <rect x='43' y='14' width='14' height='3' fill='#e63950'/>
  <!-- stick arms -->
  <path d='M36 46 L22 38' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 46 L78 38' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M22 38 L17 33 M22 38 L18 43' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 38 L83 33 M78 38 L82 43' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
